description: This Java class 'FreeMarkerWorker' provides utilities for working with the FreeMarker template engine within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for configuration, template rendering, cache management, exception handling, and integration with OFBiz components and properties.

classes.name: FreeMarkerWorker
classes.description: Utility class for managing FreeMarker templates within OFBiz, including configuration, rendering, caching, and exception handling.

classes.name: FlexibleTemplateLoader
classes.description: Custom FreeMarker TemplateLoader to locate templates by resource identifier, supporting component:// paths and database-stored templates.

methods.name: getDefaultOfbizWrapper
methods.description: Returns the default BeansWrapper configured for OFBiz.

methods.name: newConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new FreeMarker Configuration instance with default version.

methods.name: makeConfiguration
methods.description: Initializes and returns a FreeMarker Configuration with custom settings, loaders, and transforms.

methods.name: transformsURL
methods.description: Provides a stream of URLs for freemarkerTransforms.properties files from components.

methods.name: loadTransforms
methods.description: Loads and sets custom FreeMarker transforms from properties into the configuration.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a template identified by location with a given context and output writer.

methods.name: renderTemplateFromString
methods.description: Renders a template from a string, with optional caching and last modification time.

methods.name: clearTemplateFromCache
methods.description: Removes a template from the cache.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a FreeMarker Template object with a context into an Appendable.

methods.name: applyUserSettings
methods.description: Applies locale and timezone settings to the FreeMarker Environment.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a Template from cache or loads it if not present.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from args or context in the FreeMarker environment.

methods.name: getWrappedObject
methods.description: Extracts the underlying object from a FreeMarker variable.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets a value from SimpleHash args with unwrapping.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps a FreeMarker TemplateModel to its Java object.

methods.name: createEnvironmentMap
methods.description: Creates a map of current FreeMarker environment variables.

methods.name: saveContextValues
methods.description: Saves specified keys from context into a map, making collections writable.

methods.name: saveValues
methods.description: Creates a copy of specified context values, making collections writable.

methods.name: reloadValues
methods.description: Restores saved values into context and environment variables.

methods.name: removeValues
methods.description: Removes specified keys from a context map.

methods.name: overrideWithArgs
methods.description: Overrides context entries with provided args, converting to strings.

methods.name: getSiteParameters
methods.description: Populates context with site parameters from HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: autoWrap
methods.description: Wraps a Java object into a FreeMarker TemplateModel.

methods.name: handleTemplateException
methods.description: Handles template exceptions quietly, logging and replacing output.

methods.name: handleTemplateExceptionVerbosily
methods.description: Handles template exceptions verbosely, logging and outputting the message.
